🎬 Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 (2025)

Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 continues the terrifying story of Freddy Fazbear’s Pizza, where dark secrets and deadly animatronics return to haunt those connected to the abandoned restaurant. One year after the horrifying events of the first film, Mike Schmidt and police officer Vanessa try to protect Mike’s younger sister Abby from the truth about her mysterious animatronic friends. However, when Abby attempts to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica, and Foxy, she unknowingly sets off a terrifying chain of events. As new animatronics emerge and disturbing secrets about Freddy’s past are uncovered, the characters face increasingly dangerous encounters. Filled with suspense, shocking scares, and unexpected twists, the sequel explores family, survival, and the terrifying consequences of secrets that refuse to stay buried.

🎭 Genre: Horror • Mystery • Thriller

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 44m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Emma Tammi

✍️ Writer: Scott Cawthon

🎮 Based On: The Five Nights at Freddy’s video game franchise.
